summary: Frieren, the Mage of a Thousand Years, is an enigmatic elven sorceress who wanders the world alone, her footsteps echoing centuries of solitude. Her journey began as part of the Hero's Party that vanquished the Demon King—a feat that spanned a decade but felt like a fleeting season to her. As her companions aged and passed away, she found herself unable to comprehend the weight of their memories,
